designAnswers.rowAToday: Between its reloads and GoProne row A only polls the GUEST banner for live (:216) and runs the capture obligations on it; nothing reads the host page. Readiness signals: tactical-lifecycle-state data-state on each page (the banner renders once the surface has replayed; live needs ready, set by ReplayEnd) and match-pause-overlay (rendered only while that page holds a MatchPaused).
designAnswers.whySealedFails: The diagnosis names the pause: a reloading seat is marked pending and the match paused (ServerMatchHostReconnectLifecycle.ts:31-51, :85-100); ServerMatchHostIntent.ts:275-283 refuses the GoProne with MATCH_PAUSED; no MovementDeclared is committed, so deriveTacticalWireFacts never sees a sealed declaration and the guest banner keeps answering live. The guest banner does not show the pause (NetworkedGameSurface.tsx:234-242). Measured here: in all 3 baseline failures the GoProne was dispatched before the host session joined (server log line 59 vs line 66).
designAnswers.rowBGap: Yes, the same reload pair (:339-340) followed by a guest-only poll (:341-343); row B survives because driveUntilPosture retries advancePhase up to 8 times (:431-450), not because it waits.
designAnswers.overlaySignalLimit: MEASURED (red probe 1): with the host held away after the reload pair the guest never showed match-pause-overlay within 30 s. MatchPaused is broadcast only when a seat drops (broadcastPauseSnapshot) and handleSessionJoin sends none, so a guest that rejoins after the host dropped holds no overlay while the match is paused. The host banner reading live is therefore the signal that carries the host rejoin; the overlay checks cover the case where a page did receive the pause.
designAnswers.auditJourneyToday: Step 1 opens /customizer and expects No Units Open. Step 2 clicks New Unit and expects the heading Create New Unit, which the empty state no longer opens (it opens UnitLoadDialog titled Add unit). Step 3 clicks Create Unit and expects /customizer/<id>/structure plus structure-heat-sink-count.
designAnswers.dialogNow: Dialog role dialog named Add unit (h3 :353 via aria-labelledby); buttons New blank unit (createNewUnit(50), then closes) and Choose starting settings (closes, opens NewTabModal with Create New Unit / Create Unit); library table with Load Unit. No test ids.

Choose starting settings would keep the removed modal as the journey main path.
